description_en: Queries the processing result and status of a submitted certificate application
description_zh: 申请证书提交结果查询
name: GetTaskAttribute

parameters.help_en: The type of the asynchronous task. The default value is ApplyCertificate, which specifies a query for the result of a certificate application
parameters.help_zh: ApplyCertificate异步任务提交结果查询，默认入参ApplyCertificate
parameters.name: task_type

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates this ID for each request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskStatus.description_en:
The result of the task.

success: The submission is successful.

processing: The submission is in progress.

failed: The submission failed
TaskStatus.description_zh:
任务结果。
success 提交成功。
processing 提交中。
failed 提交失败
